text:
rachel: Quick pitch 
Idea: when users finish the pricing calculator, show a small 'what's next?' nudge with 3 choices: Request demo / Register for webinar / Continue self-serve. Capture intent without a modal.

dom: Nice. Can the nudge show contextual FAQ lines based on the estimate? e.g., >$2k -> SLA blurb.

anya: Copy tests: two headlines to AB: "See a tailored plan" vs "Cut your per-token cost". Also test CTA phrasing: "Book demo" vs "Talk to sales".

sam: Analytics: add event pricing_nudge_select with fields {path, estimate_usd, exp_id}. Debounce so we send once per session.

events-bot: experiment created: pricing_nudge_v3 (exp_99321). Start 2026-06-02.

rachel: Ops note: Sales wants leads >$1500 routed to SDR webhook. Add is_enterprise_candidate boolean.

dom: UX note: keep it inline under calculator results, keyboard accessible, and don't cover page content. I will mock variants.

anya: Also include a tiny 1-question micro-survey after CTA: "Did this help?" optional. We'll A/B with/without.

sam: I'll draft the tracking spec and webhook example: POST /webhooks/sdr {email, estimate_usd, path, is_enterprise_candidate, preferred_cta}.
